prediction.question: 祖母の屋敷で聞こえた女の声と潮の香りの正体は？
options: 黒猫が導く先にある村の祭祀
屋敷に潜む亡者の気配
村長が隠し持つ禁忌の証拠

en.title: Sinking into the Calm of the Sky Boat
en.premise: Returning to his hometown for his grandmother's funeral after decades, the protagonist encounters the village legend of the "Sora-bune" (Sky Boat). To pacify a massive ghost ship drifting through the sea of clouds, the village has upheld a cruel taboo for generations. Guided by a nameless black cat, he discovers the bloody, hidden tradition the villagers keep secret.

zh.title: 在空舟的宁静中沉没
zh.premise: 在祖母的葬礼上，主人公数十年后回到故乡，接触到村里流传的“空舟”传说。为了安抚漂浮在云海中的巨大亡灵之船，村子世代遵守着一种残酷的禁忌。被一只无名的黒猫引导，他逐渐了解到村子暗中隐藏的血腥因习真相。
